info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Ecommerce Cart Saves-v5-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Saves API provides a comprehensive endpoint for retrieving saved cart data associated with user shopping sessions. This API allows developers to access previously saved cart information, making it easier to enhance the customer experience through features like cart recovery and analysis. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms, shopping applications, and analytics tools that require quick access to user cart data. By leveraging this API, businesses can improve customer engagement and drive sales conversions.

get.summary: Save items to the shopping cart.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to save their selected items to the shopping cart, ensuring that their selections are retained for future purchases or checkout.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to save the current state of the cart. It should contain all necessary information regarding the items in the cart and any user preferences that apply.

ListEcommerceCartSavesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to saving a cart.

status.description: Indicates whether the save operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the save operation.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the save operation.

state.description: The current state of the cart after the save operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the save operation, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details regarding the save operation.

audit.description: Information about the creation and automation of the save operation.

ListEcommerceCartSavesResponse_206.description: Response schema for the cart save operation. Provides details on the status and metadata of the save operation.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the save operation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the save operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the save operation was made automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the auditing of the save operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
